FINAL GAP CLOSURE — NO MORE NARRATIVES, LIVE EVIDENCE ONLY

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Stop generating progress summaries, optimistic narratives, certifications, or estimated completion percentages.

The objective is to close every remaining production gap with verified runtime evidence.

Do not claim PASS, COMPLETE, VERIFIED, HEALTHY, or DEPLOYED unless the evidence is collected live after execution.

If evidence cannot be collected, report BLOCKED and explain exactly why.

==================================================
STEP 1 — STOP AND RECONCILE STATE
==================================================

Review every current state before taking action.

Reconcile:

- Worker state
- Deployment state
- GitHub state
- Render state
- Production state
- Health endpoint
- Version endpoint
- SHA parity
- Queue state
- Active jobs
- Open PRs

If two reports disagree:

Do NOT choose one.

Investigate until only one verified state remains.

==================================================
STEP 2 — VERIFY CURRENT DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Collect live evidence.

Return:

GitHub HEAD SHA

Render deployed SHA

Production /health SHA

Production /version SHA

Render deployment ID

Deployment timestamp

Boot timestamp

HTTP status

Provider status

Credential status

If production returns HTTP 502:

STOP.

Investigate startup.

Return root cause before continuing.

==================================================
STEP 3 — VERIFY CHAT LOADING FIX
==================================================

Run the real production application.

Test:

✓ cold start

✓ warm start

✓ existing conversation

✓ new conversation

✓ long history

✓ owner login

✓ member login

✓ refresh

✓ background

✓ foreground

✓ slow network

✓ temporary provider delay

✓ temporary Supabase delay

Verify:

No blank screen.

No infinite loading.

No frozen composer.

No duplicated messages.

No lost messages.

Cached messages appear immediately.

Composer remains usable.

==================================================
STEP 4 — VERIFY AUTONOMOUS WORKER
==================================================

Run one real engineering task.

Evidence required:

Task ID

Files changed

Commit SHA

GitHub commit URL

PR number

Merge SHA

Render deployment ID

Production verification

Ledger entry

If any stage fails:

Return:

FAILED

Stage

Reason

Recovery action

Do not mark COMPLETE.

==================================================
STEP 5 — VERIFY PRODUCTION HEALTH
==================================================

Call:

/health

/version

owner endpoints

public chat

owner chat

member registration

owner login

AI provider

database

Record:

HTTP status

Latency

Response

Errors

==================================================
STEP 6 — VERIFY SHA PARITY
==================================================

Required:

GitHub HEAD

=

Render deployment

=

/health

=

/version

If even one differs:

Return:

SHA PARITY = FAIL

Explain why.

==================================================
STEP 7 — VERIFY NO HIDDEN FAILURE
==================================================

Search for:

Pending deployments

Queued jobs

Worker retries

Failed builds

Startup crashes

Restart loops

Background exceptions

Database failures

Authentication failures

Provider failures

If found:

List each blocker.

==================================================
STEP 8 — FINAL GAP REPORT
==================================================

Return ONLY:

Current deployment

Current production SHA

GitHub SHA

SHA parity

Health

Version

Worker status

Chat loading result

Deployment result

Remaining blocker

No blocker

==================================================
FINAL DECISION
==================================================

Return exactly one of:

RELEASE READY

or

NOT RELEASE READY

If NOT RELEASE READY:

List every blocker.

Do not recommend more narratives.

Do not estimate progress.

Do not say "almost done."

Do not say "80%."

Do not say "should be fixed."

Every statement must be backed by live runtime evidence collected after this execution.
